senses.gloss: (Syriac גיר, P. Sm. 709 sq., prob. fr. גרר, cmp. גְּרָרָא) as a consequence, for &c.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 29:19">Targ. Prov. XXIX, 19</cite> (agreeing with Peshito) <he>ידע ג׳ דלא בליע</he> ed. Lag. (Var. <cite ref="F00059"><he>ולא</he></cite>, ed. <he>דידע ג׳ ולא וכ׳</he>, Peshito … <he>בלע</he>) for he understands (from being spoken to) only that he will receive no blows. [<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 23:14">Ib. XXIII, 14</cite> <he>אנת ביר וכ׳</he> Ms. (missing in ed.), read: <cite ref="C00805"><he>גיר</he></cite> (as in Peshito) thou, therefore, &c.]
